notes.title: Update 16: Scene Update
notes.notes: [h1]First, the updates![/h1][list][*][p]Known issue: There is a bug that can cause this update not to load, so far we have found that clearing the cache clears this bug up.[/p][/*][*][p]Sounds: We have gone through and equalized the sounds, so the volumes aren't as jarringly out of line with each other.[/p][/*][*][p]Intro: We have replaced the intro with an animated intro showcasing a few different characters than before.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes: We have gone through and repaired a number of bugs, including holdover scenes that were supposed to have been removed when the videos were added in.[/p][/*][*][p]Masturbation Scene's: Now, if you choose someone other than Chelsea, it will go to a second screen with your choice, and several other lines saying Chelsea, if you choose that person again, you will move on to a scene with that person.[/p][/*][*][p]Dog park: The following morning, you will move on to a new dog park scene where you can meet and interact with Grace, who will be an optional love interest soon, and the primary on the "Wholesome path", as we have been calling it in house.[/p][/*][*][p]Female MC Option: The scene with Agent Johnson, has been expanded upon slightly, and she will be an optional MC for a later DLC, or separate game. We are thinking a brothel simulator, with a fantasy edge.[/p][/*][*][p]Text Box: We heard the feedback and reduced the width of the textbox, though if there is a scene that you wish to see the whole of, the textbox can be removed with the H-Key as is standard with Ren'py games.[/p][/*][*][p]New End Menu: The new menu at the end, will allow you to select from different parts of the game to jump back to.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]What we are working on![/h2][p]As always, we are still working on more content. As a preview, we are explicitly working on the scenes based upon the players choices from the shower with Whitney.[/p][h2][/h2][p]Specifically, the Bonnie, and Moon options, which will have the greater storyline effects at present, and lead towards both the Corruption and Harem paths.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245113/c2a4cb23252f7e952d3e78d451dc413aa10dee31.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We are also working on expanding choices throughout the game, as well as a free roam mechanic.[/p][p][/p][h3]Long Term:[/h3][list][*][p]We hope, now that we have free roam, to add in some collectibles, however, we will not be adding achievements, cards, and whatnot, until the game is fully ready for release.[/p][/*][*][p]At this point, we have the kinetic line, the Satyr line, and the Succubus line, basically complete, any further changes on those lines will be minor, and based on flavor.[/p][/*][*][p]The lines still in the works are the Wholesome, and Harem lines, which will both contain pregnancy mechanics.[/p][/*][/list][h1][/h1][h2]With all that, we hope you enjoy these current updates, and look forward with us to our future updates.[/h2][p][/p][h2]And as always, Happy Gaming.[/h2][p][/p][p]PS: I'm not supposed to tell you this, but we have an idea for a free side game that will link our games in the future, that we hope you guys will love![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update 15: We're back; Island of Corruption
notes.notes:
Hello!

We are back. As was stated in our previous announcement, we were trying to port New Earth over to Unreal Engine, this did not succeed. No fault to Unreal Engine, great engine, and we will use it again someday when we create different sorts of games, but for Visual Novels, we will stick to Ren'py.

In the course of testing different aspects of the new engine however, we managed to build an entirely different game, short and simple, but we think fun :-)

As a thank you for your patience, and your purchase of our early access title, we have been in discussions with steam about providing this new short game, as a free game, for anyone who owns our existing title when this new game releases on May 9th.

The game is a simple Hypno game, and is called, "Island of Corruption."

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3658220/Island_of_Corruption/

We have never done a free game like this on steam, so not really sure whether notifications will go out or not, so Wishlist today, as not to miss this opportunity, as it will be here and gone before you know it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245113/4b0f5f718655ded46f55591d4048e8f4b7ffaa05.jpg[/img]

As for the radio silence since last August, it has been a very busy year, not just with the game stuff, but with personal business that has taken up a tremendous amount of our time and efforts, that would normally have been dedicated to crafting our game.

But with the new title complete, we are back onto New Earth: Saga of the New Gods, and as we said before the attempted port, we are nearly done with the game, and once complete, we will upload the new bits and bobs, as well as a few new tricks we have picked up, and move on to two additional titles, both related to the Saga, as well as the first DLC's of the Saga.

The Future:

DLC: The first DLC which should follow fairly quickly, will be more Kinetic than Visual Novel, following the course of the continuing novels that my husband has written, followed by both paid and free DLC's following the other arms of the story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245113/aecd39620444e5b8b8279a736accc26496fd1307.jpg[/img]

New Title:

1. Island of Corruption: This short stand-alone Visual Novel is complete, and ready to be enjoyed. It will be provided free to everyone who already owns New Earth Saga of the New Gods, when released on the 9th, will be 2.99 purchased a la carte, and available at 10% off with a new FPCGameSoftware bundle we will be putting out. - This title is expandable and will be if it is popular.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245113/c2cbd1dcf4ce9542f93a977937e3a67bfa56bb7e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 14: Unreal Engine
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245113/999722af8b1bb02455119b587b5d0c42c9bd4b14.png[/img]

Hello!

Apologies for the long hiatus, but we have been beating our heads against the wall of Ren'Py for a long time, and have finally surrendered, lol. It has served us very well, but it has now reached its limitations, and we must, perforce, evolve.

It is time, to put our dear friend, to bed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245113/7a27a69c5e430837d7b8447ff4829bb48e880fc6.png[/img]

And welcome her big sister, Unreal Engine!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245113/665324ea206a4d647cb70ed74fd0ffb4002bd7c7.png[/img]

To give more detail, we have been running into issues with the detailed mapping, and video performance on Ren'Py since the beginning, and we believe that the program built into Unreal Engine, Blueprint, will allow us much greater versatility.

For those of you who have already purchased our game in its current state, there will be no additional price increase. When we release the new version, it should simply erase, and replace, the old.

Thank you for your patience during this transition.

notes.title: 50% off sale!
notes.notes:
Hello fans of the Saga of the New Gods, and Adult Visual Novels in general. This sale is part of the leadup to our final release, which will hopefully be coming soon... and hopefully not in the geological sense.

Before we release, we would like to have enough reviews to get into the, "Very positive/Mostly positive/Positive/Never make another game again you jerk's (Hopefully not that last one)." Thus, this sale.

This sale will last 2 weeks, and is the deepest price cut we have ever done, even deeper than our original early access release.

So, I hope you all take advantage of this discount, buy the game, (If not for yourself, then a friend) leave a review, and make our eventual release so much better.

PS. The husband is chomping at the bit to get writing the first DLC, and I keep having to reign him back on course, so wish me luck!

notes.title: Happy New Years!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Now that our most recent animation update has come out, we are hard at work on our next update!

Not only will the next update come with some new, and updated animations, it will come with the long awaited, (by some, hopefully, lol) wholesome/investigative/college harem path update.

You can get to this update, when it comes out, by sticking to your guns on the dream you will have the night of the game. Just keep picking names other than Chelsea, and you will get to this storyline!

One of the story options in this line, is a date with Grace Hanrahan, a college freshman, with twin big brothers that share a college baseball team with you. Also, if you select this option, it could be a double date with Laney and Ogre, and who knows what kinda shenanigans that could lead to... seriously, I have no idea at this point. My husband does the story writing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245113/37c6d4bb877c2a7f883f2bc5d7286c42e8348d25.png[/img]

With that though, we bid you farewell, and wish you all a wonderful New Year, much fun, much love, and Happy Gaming!

notes.notes:
Greetings! And Merry Christmas!

This update completes 1 path and increases the number of animations.

We are adding approximately 400 images.
We are also adding an additional 15 animations.
This is also the update where we add in the optional female MC for a future DLC, she is a character you will encounter on every story path, but who only becomes a possible MC on the heavy corruption path.

Fair warning, the story path that has been completed here, is the heavy corruption path. Some may find it disturbing, so play this path at your own risk.

FUTURE UPDATES:

There is one remaining story path to complete, which will branch into investigative, light corruption, and college harem. Hopefully, barring any additional story elements (This does tend to happen... but hey, additional content, am I right?), this will be done fairly quickly.

We will also be redoing a few of our earlier images and animations, as well as adding several additional animations.

notes.title: Update 12: We finished our trip!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We are back from our family vacation, and back hard at work on our games!

As is frequently the case, we have good news, bad news, and in this case god awful news!

First the good!

We have completed the renders for another line of the AVN, as well as several dream sequences, and will be spending the next week or so doing the writing and coding, then loading it up for your entertainment!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245113/251086c7684c402659558ea0cb5a357a878644a2.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245113/4ea8382acacc068d7ea05ea97b8bea67d09c7d5b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245113/a01d10b61456d8fc166e1291836ae9c46adb44de.jpg[/img]

Also, for anyone at level 2 of our Patreon and beyond, we have started a dedicated Minecraft server where you can join us (subject to good behavior, of course), and mostly chat with my wife, as she plays Minecraft much more often than I! Though we are both on more often than we should be, lol.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245113/1804f8749dca129903943452e700833c27598378.jpg[/img]

Now the Bad...

Though not related to the game... Upon coming home, the entire house got covid, so our work slowed significantly during that time, and then, upon recovering... to celebrate... I broke my toe! Ouch!

But we are all feeling much better now.

Now the god awful!

As many of you know, we live way out in the middle of nowhere, on a farm. Our 4.75 lb. Yorkie decided to attack a coyote that was coming after our chickens. The heroic little dog fought off the coyote... somehow... but has since been in recovery from his injuries. He is a tough guy though, and after a lot of expense, he is doing great, and living high off the hog with his own room, his own bowl, and his own dog door, far away from any of the wildlife.

Thank you for your time, and happy gaming to all!

notes.title: Update #10 Happy Father's Day!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have good news, bad news, and awesome news!

First the awesome news! My wife has gotten a new job that has come with a substantial pay increase. This means that we will have the resources necessary to buy additional assets, licenses, and equipment, and that will mean our games will be that much more numerous, and high quality!

As I said, awesome, right?

But, that leads us into the bad news. My wife is the main coder for our games, as well as our photo editor, and graphics person. As this is a new job, it is taking up nearly all her time. So, we had a choice, start releasing updates of lower quality, and fewer animations, or slow the actual game updates for a time. So, we are slowing our game updates, though this does mean that when we do update, these updates will be substantially larger, as I will be continuing to create the base images and animations that will que up for editing.

Bad, but not that bad.

Now the good news! As I am incapable of mastering the intricacies of photoshop, because I do not have an artist's eyes, I will be using some of our new equipment to create another game, set in the same universe of New Earth, sometime in the future. This game is set roughly in the time period of our future AVN Title, "New Earth Book 3", and will be a survival, postapocalyptic, sprite game. It will be made in a similar vein to games like Shelter, from that amazing creator, Winterlook.

I am creating this new game as a teaching exercise for myself, to improve my coding skills, and we will price this title to match :-)

I very much hope you enjoy it when it comes out!


The two images with this new update are from the new project:

The header image is a dad helping his family down into a storm shelter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245113/05ee19c8641880b8ecf01f61ab08c3cc5fd13403.png[/img]

The cover image is an example of some of the dangers involved in gathering herbs as an elf girl in a magical post-apocalyptic world!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245113/a8e493eb2af756339c6ced1842b6472fc5cb9ba2.png[/img]


The imbedded image is a mug my son gave me :-)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245113/b1f5ea12f30ae969d9289693220175a0e44e4256.jpg[/img]

notes.title: #9 ReelBooks Entertainment
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! And Happy Mother's Day!

These past few weeks, we have been working very hard on this game, in particular on the animations for the game. In the process, we discovered we quite enjoy animating, and have decided to expand upon the animations within the game.

We have also started a new company called ReelBooks Entertainment, that has the goal to convert books, word for word (Whenever possible), into animated web series!

So, as we said, we will be including a lot more animations in our games.

Also, following behind our games, will be a web series that will follow the main narrative path of the game. Due to the rules of most services that we can put a web series on, we will be placing the NSFW content on another site, where it is considered somewhat more acceptable. Hopefully, after we have completed this web series. We will be able to find other authors willing to allow us to create animations following their books. In particular, we will be inquiring of Jack L Chalker, Robert A. Heinlein's estate, and Jim Butcher, just because if any writers deserved their works spread to a wider audience, it's these three.

Thank you,
and, as always, Happy Gaming!

PS; Also, we have a surprise coming for those of our Patrons tier 2 and beyond. I'm dying to tell all, but my wife is insisting on secrecy until we have everything in order.

notes.title: #7 Update
notes.notes:
Hello again!

Thanks to all of you, this was an amazing launch of a first title, thank you all very much for your faith in our game, and we will strive to be worthy of your trust.

Originally, our intention had been to work exclusively on repairing the animations and updating the initial narrative. But then we realized how foolish that would be of us, lol. It would trap us in a permanent holding pattern, with no growth, only continuous development of a single narrative.

So instead, we will be adding additional content to the game, until we have the entire storyline out, and will work at the same time, on the animation repairs our main storyline needs. Which will hopefully result in a great and growing experience for all of you.

Now, of the paths we are planning, we are working on the paths that split off from the main narrative at the baseball game, at the very start of the game, when the MC has to decide, "Do I go with Michelle, or stay at the field?"

notes.title: Early Access Release!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Today is the day! Today we do our Early Access launch!

Current numbers:
approximately 1000 images
approximately 40 animations
a fairly large number of sound and music files

Future numbers will be substantially larger, hopefully doubling or more the number of animations and images, especially now that we have a dedicated animation machine.

We have begun the process of adding in the alignment and choices system, but as of now they have limited functionality, with the notable exception of, "embrace the power," the answer is, yes.

As of update 2 and beyond, we will be adding new and more important choices, that will lead to additional LI's, and a few additional endings.

So yet again... we wish you Happy gaming!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245113/94597c6d65c1c514b8112615d1765bd3ac246c41.jpg[/img]

Hopefully, with a good chunk of the basic information already being built into the game, this process will go quickly, allowing us to meet our self-imposed deadline of full release within 3 months.

Either way, it'll be a fun ride!
Have fun, and Happy Gaming!

notes.title: #5 Update Release Date Change
notes.notes:
Hello all!

Today we are coding coding coding! And things are coming on very nicely.

That being said, what with the massive release coming 4 days before our scheduled release date, we have decided to put off our release date for a couple of weeks, to Friday, March 3rd.

We here at FPCGameSoftware hate delays, so this was a very difficult decision. But the final deciding factor on this was, there is a lot of overlap in fan bases between fantasy and AVN's, and some of our fans have a limited game budget. We don't want anyone of our potential fans to have to decide between getting our game at the 40% release discount, or waiting on a huge game they may be interested in.

Thank you!
and Happy Gaming!

notes.title: #1 Progress Report
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

We have good news over here at FPCGameSoftware. The game, New Earth: Saga of the New Gods, is coming along nicely, and we are well on our way to a successful, and possibly early, early access launch.
